articleBodyHtml:
Introduction to the Game

The Hololive Official Card Game is a strategic card game that involves placing and managing Holomams, using Bloom mechanics, and executing Arts to deal damage. The game is played with a main deck, cheer deck, and specific rules for movement and actions during different phases.

Game Setup and Initial Actions

At the start of the game, players must place their Holomams on the stage and follow specific rules for movement and positioning. For example, during the reset phase, the collab Holomam is moved to the back position with the resting state, and if the center position is empty, a back Holomam must be moved to the center position.

timeline.text: Hey guys, I'm Takanashi Kiara, and I will be your tutor today!
Thank you very much for participating in today's Whole Life Official Card Game Learning Session!
Today, I will introduce how to play the Whole Life Official Card Game that is currently released!
This event is going to be about 50 minutes, starting with a demonstration, followed by free playtime.
At the end of the event, we'll be handing out a PR Pack as a participation gift, so please enjoy the learning session today!
Before we begin the event, we would like to request your cooperation with the following.
Please don't take home any of the cards or items used during this event.
You are welcome to take photos of the cards and your gameplay and share them on social media.
Just be sure to not include any other participants in your photos. When posting, please use the hashtags.
Let's keep these in mind and have fun playing!
Once you have completed this setup, we will declare the start and turn the Holomam cards over.
The call is LIFE START! Let's all say it together with me and flip the cards over, okay?
Once you have revealed your Oshiholomam and the Center Holomam, the last step is to prepare your life.
Life is prepared from the pile of cards on the left called the CHEER deck.
The CHEER deck contains CHEER cards, which help support the Holomam in their performance.
The number of life depends on your Oshiholomam. Please check the bottom right of your Oshiholomam.
For Azuki, the life is 6, and for Toki no Sora, the life is 5.
So take those number of cards from your CHEER deck and put it face down in the life area.
We can place more Holomam in the back position.
To do so, take card 2, Amane Kanata, and card 3, Hakui Koyori, from your hand
and place them in the lower half of the playmat, the back position.
These two cards have SPOT written in the top left corner, and they are called SPOT Holomam.
During the main phase, you can place DEBUT Holomam or SPOT Holomam in the back position.
There are many other actions you can take during your turn,
but in the first player's turn, your options are limited.
However, there is one more thing you can do this turn that I'd like to introduce, and that is Collab.
Now it's the main phase.
Let's place the spot Holomam Hakui Koyori card 2 and the debut Holomam Toki no Sora card 3 into the back position.
Let's place the spot Holomam Hakui Koyori card 2 and the debut Holomam Toki no Sora card 3 into the back position.

Bloom is the process by which the Holomam's arts and abilities are improved, so let's bloom and make them shine on stage.
Debut Holomam can bloom to any first.
First Holomam can bloom to any first and or second.
So, let's place Azuki card 4 on your center Holomam from your hand.
Bloom is a very powerful mechanic, but be careful.
You need to follow these rules.
No players can bloom during their first turn, whether going first or second.
It cannot be used on a Holomam that was placed on the stage during that turn.
At first, during the reset phase, you move the collab Holomam to the back position with the resting state.
If the center position is empty during the reset phase, you need to move a back Holomam to the center position.
Currently, Hakoi Koyori has the resting state and Toki no Sora has the active state in the back position.
If there is an active Holomam, they should be prioritized for the center position.
OK? So, let's move Toki no Sora free to the center position.
Now, the phase is moved to the draw phase.
You draw a card.
What's next? Yeah, that's right, the cheer phase.
Now, let's move to the main phase.
Place the card 5, second Azuki, onto the center Holomem for first Azuki to bloom it.
Next, perform a collab.
From the main deck, place one card face down to accumulate holo power.
And move the back holomem to Amane Kanata to the collab position.
Everyone, please take a look at the arts of 5 Azuki.
Currently, since three green cheers have been sent to Azuki, we can use the second arts, Destiny Song.
This art not only deals damage, but also has an additional ability.
If the die roll is odd, it adds 50 damage to the base arts damage of 100, making it a total of 150 damage.
Since the center holomember, Tokino Sora, on the opponent's side has 150 HP, if we roll an odd number, we will be able to down her in one hit.
Please separate the main deck into numbered and non-numbered cards, and divide the cheer deck by color.
Lastly, an announcement! The Hololive Official Card Game that you played today has been released on July 11th, 2025.
Information about future products and upcoming events will be updated on the Hololive Official Card Game's ex-account and official website.
So, check it out! Don't miss it! Once you receive PR packs, you can feel free to leave.
